name: Skip Duplicate Actions
description: Skip duplicate workflow runs. Skip or ignore specific paths. Cancel outdated workflow runs.

paths_ignore.description: A JSON-array with ignored path patterns

paths_filter.description: A YAML-string with named paths_ignore/paths patterns

cancel_others.description: If true, then workflow runs from outdated commits will be cancelled

skip_after_successful_duplicate.description: If true, skip if an already finished duplicate run can be found

do_not_skip.description: A JSON-array with triggers that should never be skipped

concurrent_skipping.description: One of never, same_content, same_content_newer, outdated_runs, always

skip_summary.description: If true, make the workflow logs shorter
